history.name: Printing uses whatever browser the machine has
history.description: Printing an edition needs a browser, and the tool finds one in the order that asks least of the project: a browser the project already manages, otherwise the Chrome or Edge already installed on the machine, otherwise one named outright for a container or a build server. When there is none, it says so and lists each thing it tried and why that didn't work, alongside the ways to fix it.
history.dev_notes: src/render/pdf.mjs — launchBrowser(); channels chrome/msedge/chromium via playwright-core, or $LEDGER_CHROME. `ledger doctor` reports which one would be used.
